list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18 (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PSN). Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide below is written for this entry, in our own words, and names its sources; no guide text is copied from them.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5): https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap: https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/
GTA Zone — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements: https://gta-zone.com/news/gta-6-trophies-achievements/

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Plan the run around the long grinds instead: the story, the 100% checklist behind A Long Road, 250 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours, all in one playthrough with no online trophies. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PowerPyx for the difficulty and time estimate.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 — the first main mission of the game — and it unlocks at the mission's end. No preparation needed; just play the story. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PowerPyx, which lists it as an automatic story trophy in Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Play through every Chapter 1 main mission; it unlocks when the chapter closes (PowerPyx notes it pops after the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?). Before the chapter ends, do the one thing in this guide that can be missed: Lucia's balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the chapter flow and the meditation warning.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish all of Chapter 2's main missions; it unlocks as Chapter 3 begins (PowerPyx places the pop after the first Chapter 3 mission, Welcome to Vice City). Chapter 2 is where the game opens up: the Coffee Break mission unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia and free-roaming together, which most partner trophies need. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the chapter flow.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete Chapter 3; it unlocks once the first two main missions of Chapter 4 (Ocean Beach and Another Life) are done, per PowerPyx. Chapter 3 is also when several systems unlock — the Key Cloner in Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, Yasmani's jewelry jobs, and Randy's sports-car wishlist — so take the optional missions as they appear. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the chapter flow.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 4; PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the final main mission of the chapter, Starting From Zero. The Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) is worth doing as soon as it appears: it introduces the large bank-vault robberies behind Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the chapter flow and the bank-vault introduction.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the final mission (Starting From Zero, in Chapter 5 per PowerPyx's mission list) and this gold unlocks with the credits. After the story the game returns you to free-roam and the 100% completion checklist appears under Progress, so nothing is locked off by finishing. Before the finale, keep a manual save: there is no mission replay. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the final-mission placement and the no-replay warning.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run and it unlocks during the mission, per PowerPyx. Like every mission-named trophy, it comes from playing the story in order — there is no side requirement and no way to miss it. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the mission and chapter.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story beat, not a free-roam robbery: the robbery trophies (bank vaults, armored trucks, jewelry stores) are separate trophies with their own requirements. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the mission and chapter.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Keep playing the story in order and it unlocks on its own; the only thing to watch in Chapter 4 is the optional bank-vault mission That's Where The Money Is…, which unlocks the vault robberies rather than this trophy. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the mission and chapter.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It unlocks during the mission itself, per PowerPyx. No preparation, no side content and no timing window apply — just reach it in the story. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the mission and chapter.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. The free-roam airport trophy Catch Me If You Can is a different trophy — stealing a docked airliner and flying it away — so do not confuse the two. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the mission and chapter.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last mission-named trophy on the list; after it, only the final mission stands between you and the gold for finishing the story. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the mission and chapter.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list and the last one most players earn. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and progress made during the story already counts. PowerPyx stresses it is lenient — closer to 60% true completion: scan any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study any 100 of 255 animals with binoculars, complete any 100 optional missions, any 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 15 of 18 meditations, and all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing toward 100% is missable and everything is doable in post-story free-roam. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the checklist rules and thresholds.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida (the 100% checklist needs 300). There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 Under the Bridges flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps — mix them freely and pick the easiest. PowerPyx calls Under the Bridges the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where each stunt keeps its unique name once done. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the counts, categories and tracking.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your count at Touchpad > Progress > Activities, and filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icons). PowerPyx notes you are introduced to most of them through the story and will do one of each naturally while chasing the other trophies, so do not grind this one early. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the 9 types and where to track them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 shooting-range locations. PowerPyx links a full location guide and notes the gold medals are not too difficult. Shooting ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps the Gunslinger trophy, and every range is required for the 100% checklist, so this is a core grind rather than a side one. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PowerPyx for the 12 locations and 42 challenges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total, per PowerPyx). You only need one win per location, not every race. Drone races also count as a race win for Master of None, and all of them are required for the 100% checklist. Learn each course's racing line first, then go for the win — the races stay available in free-roam. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the 14 locations and 42 races.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations PowerPyx lists. Each location counts once, so vary the races instead of repeating one you like. Car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races all feed the race side of Master of None as well. Pick shorter circuits first and upgrade your car between attempts if a race feels out of reach. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the 40 race locations.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the fishing challenge it sets up. Fishing also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, and catching fish helps raise Focus. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the Cal questline trigger.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all levels of any one of the 4 arcade video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1 (it can be briefly unavailable during some story sections, but returns after the story); Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines out in the world. You only need to reach the end once — beating every challenge is not required — so pick the game you find easiest. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the 4 games and where to play them.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5-quest optional line, which is exclusive to Lucia and marked automatically in Chapter 3: she calls, then texts her home address in Belville. The quests are Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van) and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse). All of it stays available after the story. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the quest names, the Lucia-only restriction and the Chapter 3 trigger.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving line. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1; a while after the mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton) he calls and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map — find the underwater treasure with the metal detector, dig it up and bring it back. There are 7 shipwrecks in total across several sets; after each set he calls you back for more. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3 (PowerPyx notes calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds this up). Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the shipwreck count and the return timing.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5-quest line at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County, marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break. The quests are Thrillbillies (check out the mud club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes — the last one is the trophy. All of it stays available after the story. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the quest names and the Coffee Break trigger.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Only certain strangers count — PowerPyx confirms Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunt: Skunk Apeology 101, tree effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, collecting chemicals, Buddy?), Yago (street race, mentoring, racing and backing him up) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile quests and package deliveries). Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. Every strand stays available after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for which strangers count and which do not.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List: deliver the 16 sports cars he wants. The line is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; he marks some cars in fixed locations, but you can also steal one off the street — scanning a car with the WAiNK app tells you if it is wanted, and a popup offers delivery when you enter one. He is marked by the green RK icon in west Vice City, and delivering cars in good condition pays more. Sports cars are common around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the 16-car list and how delivery works.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's line, which is exclusive to Jason and marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City: destroy the labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter, and once enough are destroyed Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This (shut down the labs), which unlocks the trophy. All of it stays available after the story. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the Jason-only restriction, the lab quest names and the Chapter 3 trigger.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts +2. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. Do the Chapter 1 meditation first: after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow and choose Accept. That balcony meditation is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and PowerPyx reports it is still unconfirmed whether it is required, so do it to be safe (its author earned the trophy after doing it). The last spot needs both characters playable together, which unlocks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18, so this trophy is stricter than 100%. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the 18 spots, the Chapter 1 balcony steps and the unconfirmed-requirement warning; Output Lag and KeenGamer agree it is the only possibly missable trophy.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Do Bret Vogel's hunting line. It is exclusive to Jason and marked after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts you about the first quest, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret), in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons: hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker); one clean shot keeps a kill pristine and pays more, but is not required. Track progress under Map > Activities > Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks and all 15 are needed for 100%, so this comes naturally. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the trigger, the rifle and the unconfirmed-animal note.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx lists 18 card-set locations across Leonida; cards are a collectible type, and like the other collectibles they are only partially required — you need 3 sets, not all 18. Pick up cards as you explore and check your set progress in the collections menu; finish the sets you are closest to completing first rather than starting new ones. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the 18 set locations.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app: hold Up, then R1, while looking at a scannable object. There are far more than 100 — PowerPyx breaks them down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher Tags — so any 100 count. Make scanning a habit from Chapter 1 (the app unlocks early and scanning also feeds Whip It Good and the 100% checklist, which needs 200 scanned vehicles). Landmarks and curiosities cluster in Vice City, so a slow drive through town with the app ready racks them up fast. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the category counts.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. Track them under Progress > Challenges (the checkmark in the bottom right shows completion when you scroll over one). Most complete naturally while chasing the other trophies and the 100% checklist — which needs any 70 of 80 — so leave this for late in the run, then pick the easiest remaining ones: there are 10 more challenges than 100% needs, so you can skip the hardest. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the 80 total and the 70-for-100% rule.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. It only becomes possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Cause carnage until you hit 4 stars, then break out of the search area on a fast sports motorcycle; PowerPyx recommends driving through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. The trophy pops after you leave the red heat zone, not the flashing search area. It also comes automatically while robbing the large bank vaults (which always trigger 4 stars). Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the unlock timing, the partner call and the tunnel route.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner (available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break), rob 3 shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time — do not lose the wanted level between shops. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix/Adrenaline) from an Ammu-Nation. PowerPyx suggests the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, which open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a couple of items in each, break the back-room safe with sticky bombs, and if the trophy has not popped after the third shop, hit a fourth — the unlock is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the jewelry-store route and the delayed pop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The fastest way is the WAiNK app (hold Up to open it instantly): stand on a busy road and scan every vehicle that passes — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes), and the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this trophy falls out naturally on the way there. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the 557-vehicle total and the scan method.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus: while aiming a firearm, press L3 + R3 to slow time — it highlights vulnerable spots and drains the purple focus bar under your health and stamina. First raise your Focus (level 4 is easiest): play shooting ranges, golf, pool, fish, and land headshots. Before the attempt, eat or drink to buff focus, wash up at home, and take Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to stretch the slow-time window. Line up 5 enemies — PowerPyx suggests criminals at gang operations — and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556, with body armor on so you can step out of cover. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the controls, the Adrenaline tip and the target restriction.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — planes sitting on the open airfield do not count. PowerPyx points to the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane by the boarding bridge, use the stairs and door beside the bridge to get inside, go upstairs to the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip and take off. Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport; the trophy pops with a slight delay. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the E3/E4 plane and the 1 km rule.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino tank. They stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County: drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops. Expect a heavy military response — the tank's armor is the point, so keep moving and use its cannon rather than getting out to fight on foot. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the Mile Zero location and entry.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks jewelry-store robberies and the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors. Then enter a jewelry store through its back door: when you approach the locked door, choose the Snap Gun prompt instead of kicking it (kicking triggers the alarm). Inside, find the note with the safe code in the back room and loot the safe. PowerPyx recommends Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. Stay quiet throughout — being spotted fails the stealth condition. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the Snap Gun, the back-door route and the store.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape (all 8 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this comes automatically). First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which introduces vault robberies: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then slip in while the guard's briefcase opens the vault. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the cash alone, so hold Right to hand off a bag. After that, Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 (once you have done his earlier Payday Loans jobs). Each vault pays up to $205,000 and instantly gives a 4-star wanted level: escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the intro mission, the van tips and the 8 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat radius. The easiest route is the same Chapter 4 optional mission as Maximum Withdrawal — That's Where The Money Is… — since robbing a bank vault there counts as robbing an armored truck. For an earlier method, find armored trucks driving near banks in Vice City, block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests). Either way, the trophy only pops once you have escaped the heat radius. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for both methods and the escape condition.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map — fly over every black-fogged area until the whole of Leonida is visible. A plane is the fastest tool: sweep the map region by region rather than driving every road. This pairs naturally with the stunts, WAiNK scans and drone races, which all pull you across the state anyway. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the unfog-by-plane method.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total (all 39 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this comes automatically); they appear as yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically through story progress. Track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed. Do one per gang early to bank the trophy, then clear the rest during the 100% cleanup. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the 9 gangs, 39 operations and the tracking menu.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as currently unknown, and no other guide we checked has pinned it down yet. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so the likely trigger is ordering or drinking a cocktail at a beachfront spot on Ocean Beach; try the bars and venues along the beachfront and any drink prompt with a view. Treat any specific method you read elsewhere as unverified until a guide confirms it in-game. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PowerPyx, which marks this trophy unknown.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window — only that specific blue Banshee counts. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Hack into the car, drive forward through the glass, and keep driving: the trophy pops with a slight delay once you are out on the street. It is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the blue Banshee, the showroom and the Key Cloner requirement.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. It is marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation to blow the safe. Inside, take the luxury watch from the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 from the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item — and it is not missable: if you miss one, the robbery icon respawns after a while and you can return for the remaining valuables. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the 3 valuables and the respawn note.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same time. This only becomes possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between characters. Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia (heart icon). Raise it by working out — buy a gym membership at a fitness club (filter the map by Activities, dumbbell icon) and always bring your partner along (hold Right, press Triangle to call them): while one character works out, the other trains automatically, doubling progress. You can also work out at home after the story. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the max-strength-both rule and the train-together trick.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count out of 500. Turn on notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On): a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. The profile runs Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes, destroying evidence), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (large-scale killing, driving over gravestones) to Irredeemable — which is permanent, so avoid excessive violence if you want cops to stay less aggressive. It accrues passively through robberies and fights, so it should land on its own; if it is last, farming it is simply more of the same. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 500 target; PowerPyx for the profile tiers and the notification setting.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The description ('Second time's the charm') suggests retrying something that failed once, so if you fail a Payday Loans robbery or a related early interaction, try it again rather than moving on. Treat any specific method you read elsewhere as unverified until a guide confirms it in-game. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx, which marks this trophy unknown with the Payday Loans belief.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as currently unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline. The description suggests witnessing something strange, so keep an eye out for unusual lights or encounters in remote Leonida, especially at night, and follow up any odd event the game flags. Treat any specific UFO method you read elsewhere as unverified until a guide confirms it in-game. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx, which marks this trophy unknown with the UFO-questline belief.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. The description ('bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by') points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle: try riding a motorcycle through enemies and using the melee kick as you pass, ideally at bowling-alley speed on a straight stretch with a few targets grouped together. Treat any specific method you read elsewhere as unverified until a guide confirms it in-game. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx, which marks this trophy unknown with the motorcycle-kick belief.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts (fences). First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total is cumulative, so you do not need $250,000 at once, and it comes naturally from the robbery grind: a single large bank vault pays up to $205,000. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the Credit Check unlock, the fence tip and the cumulative total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops — the total is cumulative across every shop type. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns at the 24 Ammu-Nations, car mods at the 14 mod shops, and tattoos at the 11 tattoo studios. Clothing stores (67), footwear (17), hair and beauty salons (18) and electronics stores (15) all count too. Do not grind this early: buy what the other trophies need (armor, sticky bombs, gym memberships, garage properties) and the total climbs on its own. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the shop counts and the fastest-spend tip.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (the 4 story-related garages do not count). They cost $160,000 in total and become available after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone — buy them through that app. The fastest money comes from robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4, so this is a late-run purchase. Garages also add parking spots, which you need to register vehicles for On the Spot. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the 8 garages, the $160,000 total and the Real Estate app.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, choose Respray then Register. You need enough garage parking spots first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds spots. At first Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx for the Moses flow, the tracker rules and the cheap-vehicle tip.
